items.title: 22.2 Tbps DDoS Attack Breaks Internet With New World Record
items.description: Cloudflare announced it had autonomously mitigated the largest distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack ever recorded. The hyper-volumetric attack peaked at an unprecedented 22.2 terabits per second (Tbps) and 10.6 billion packets per second (Bpps), setting a new and alarming benchmark for the scale of cyber threats.
